key_insight: Variational optimization can compensate for hardware imperfections in optical polarization-qubit experiments, achieving performance comparable to conventional polarization compensation.
engineering_relevance: Automated tuning could help quantum-network nodes maintain polarization control despite noisy, imperfect hardware.
method: Parameterize prepare-and-measure protocols for variational optimization.
Optimize protocol settings on an optical testbed.
Compare gradient estimation methods and analyze hardware imperfections and dark counts.
evidence_signal: The optical proof-of-principle demonstration reports polarization compensation comparable to conventional methods, but the abstract provides no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Performance on deployed fiber-network nodes remains unverified, and hardware imperfections and dark counts can affect optimization.
paper_title: Variational Quantum Optimization of Noisy Polarization Qubit Experiments
